title: Add printable worksheet CSS
goal: Create print CSS for worksheet HTML exports and browser print-to-PDF.
context: Print export should be CSS over the same worksheet content, not a separate content system.
acceptance: Name/date/class fields render on student pages
Letter and A4 page size options are documented or represented
Large-font, dyslexia-friendly, and black-and-white printer modes are represented
Page-break controls include one-question-per-page support or a documented hook
notes: Do not implement custom PDF generation in this task.
